NAM.note: ECN says it hosts its data locally under its own IT policies; that is its practice, not a government rule.

facts.fact: The Electoral Commission of Namibia says its custom-made digital biometric voter registration system, in use since 2014, is still effective, and an enhanced Integrated Mobile Voter Registration System began production use for the general registration of voters on 3 June 2024.

NAM.note: Nothing on a national ID system.

facts.fact: The Electoral Commission of Namibia says its voter registration system is managed under its internal IT policies and that it has a fully-fledged IT Division entrusted with managing its IT systems.
